title: Ako Bicol Party-list: No infra insertions in proposed 2027 budget

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Ako Bicol Party-list did not request or sponsor any infrastructure funding in the 2027 General Appropriations Bill (GAB). Ako Bicol Rep. Jan Almario Chan on Saturday made that clarification in a statement issued on Saturday following reports from Bilyonaryo News Channel (BNC) that the First District of Camarines Sur obtained more than P10 billion in infrastructure funds in the proposed national budget for next year. “ZERO,” Chan stressed in a statement. “Not a single peso in infrastructure funding was requested for or allocated to the Ako Bicol Party-list,” he added in Filipino.
